title: Design System: CodeByAbi Developer Game World

body.purpose: Project descriptions and readable supporting copy.

motion.name: ambient-loop
motion.purpose: Continuous world activity such as floating hardware, runners, paths, and scan lines.

motion.name: stepped-status
motion.purpose: Cursors, indicator lights, and pixel-state changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Stops animation while preserving every object's correct static position.

components.name: Game Panel
components.description: Large dark HUD container for a complete game system.

components.name: Portal
components.description: Compact game control linking to a real destination.

components.name: Mission Tile
components.description: A truthful repository summary inside the mission-select system.

narrative.overview: The profile is one continuous developer game world rather than a stack of unrelated badges or generated banners. Every surface looks like part of the same late-night build session. The world is playful but useful: visitors understand Abi's role, projects, activity, and contact paths without decoding the theme.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-black layered surfaces with four sparse signal colors.
Crisp one-pixel rules, pixel characters, and authored vector icons.
Monospaced HUD typography with strong size and weight steps.
Continuous game language across hero, portals, missions, data, and contribution history.
GitHub-safe SVG motion with a complete reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: Signal Discipline
rules.body: Signal colors label meaning; they do not become decorative gradients or full-surface washes.

rules.name: HUD Legibility
rules.body: Expanded tracking belongs to short labels only; project descriptions and actionable names stay compact enough to scan on mobile.

rules.name: Console Layer
rules.body: Use tonal separation and one-pixel structure for hierarchy; do not add ambient card shadows or translucent glass.

dos: Do keep every new section inside the same developer-game vocabulary.
Do use real repositories, verified public counts, and generated contribution data.
Do author SVG icons and motion with readable static and reduced-motion states.
Do preserve the direct route from project art to working GitHub links.
donts: Don't reintroduce badge walls, unrelated stats services, or standalone generated hero art.
Don't mix glassmorphism, gradients, soft dashboard cards, or generic portfolio templates into the console world.
Don't invent employers, awards, clients, metrics, or project outcomes.
Don't let animation change an object's base coordinates or cover readable text.
